title: Λ-EG — Emergent Gravitational Coherence: Theory, Ontology, Cosmology (T.O.C.)
description: Canonical consolidated record of the Λ-EG (Lambda Emergent Gravity) programme by J. Pablo Figueroa Torres. Includes: the covariant scalar-tensor emergent-gravity framework (v7, with the a0 = 4*pi*g_crit zero-point correction); the confrontation with JADES DR4 high-redshift data; and the geometric mu-theorem (the standard MOND interpolating function mu(x)=x/sqrt(1+x^2) as the isotropic distribution of cot theta). Consolidates earlier scattered Zenodo records into a single citable lineage. Cosmology (CMB/FLRW) and ontology sections are forthcoming in future versions of this record.
